name: Simri Bakhtiarpur

queries.query: Simri Bakhtiarpur Bihar official cadastral map parcel GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of Bihar BhuNaksha viewer, the Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms portal, and the Government of India DILRMP village map-digitization record for Simri Bakhtiarpur, Saharsa. The BhuNaksha viewer is the local public cadastral-map route.

queries.query: सिमरी बख्तियारपुर बिहार आधिकारिक भू नक्शा खसरा नक्शा
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Hindi Bihar land-record portal and the same official BhuNaksha viewer. The public viewer hierarchy returned Saharsa district, Simri Bakhtiyarpur subdivision, Simri Bakhtiarpur circle, and Hindi/English location labels; no parcel feature response was obtained.

freshResearch.method: Separate English and Hindi first-party discovery followed by TLS-verified anonymous GET/POST inspection of the current BhuNaksha HTML, JavaScript and public REST routes. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields or TLS disablement were used.

portalsFound.observation: Official Bihar cadastral mapping viewer; its current page loads assets/misc/config.js and index.js and exposes public location and map routes.
Official Bihar Department of Revenue and Land Reforms page linking Bhu-Naksha and other land services.

Official DILRMP record for Bihar, Saharsa, Simri Bakhtiarpur; it reports village map digitization and Bhu-Naksha use. This supports cadastral custody/availability context, not an open geometry response.

requests.assessment: Viewer HTML retrieved. Current JavaScript references assets/misc/config.js, index.js, rest/Levels/*, rest/MapInfo/*, ScalarDatahandler and WMS.

Current configuration and client code inspected. The client uses state=10, hierarchy codes, ScalarDatahandler, getPlotAtXY, getVVVVExtentGeoref and WMS; no authentication was needed for these public files.
Returned the official hierarchy including Saharsa (12), Simri Bakhtiarpur subdivision (02), Simri Bakhtiarpur circle (08), and a mauza list containing Simri(80) with code 0402.

Returned a map extent with has_data=N (xmin=459139.7138912235, ymin=2847831.716496993, xmax=461081.363382295, ymax=2850029.8020009366). This was an extent/point miss or service limitation only; no citywide absence inference was made.
No parcel ID or geometry response. Exact WUP point was transformed only for the service's apparent projected coordinates; the WUP latitude/longitude was preserved and not shifted.
No extent response for the candidate GIS code.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Bihar's official BhuNaksha cadastral viewer and DILRMP map-digitization record for Saharsa / Simri Bakhtiarpur.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local official cadastral viewer, hierarchy metadata and map extent behavior only; no open parcel ID-plus-geometry feature was verified.
